name: Liberec-Stará Paka
description:
Head for the hills aboard trains anew in Liberec - Stará Paka from Vector Simulations! From the unique controls of the Class 843 to the iconic “Goggles” cab of the Class 750, tackle a mix of passenger & freight operations along a busy & treacherous single-track mountain pass in Train Sim World’s first Czech route.

The route which today tightly navigates its way from Liberec to Stará Paka was built in the 1850s as a section of a route from Germany to Pardubice. Born from a desire to primarily shift cargo - in particular, supporting the lucrative coal industry - the unforgiving terrain was bested by railway builders both domestic, and with the expertise from other countries more climatised to complicated rail routes.
